text:
Pittsburgh Steelers QB Aaron Rodgers completed 22 of 40 passes for 299 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions versus the Cleveland Browns in Week 4. Rodgers also ran for a two-point conversion.
SOURCE: USA TODAY
Pittsburgh Steelers QB Aaron Rodgers completed 22 of 40 passes for 299 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions versus the Cleveland Browns in Week 4. Rodgers also ran for a two-point conversion.
SOURCE: USA TODAY
Why It Matters: After opening the 2026 campaign with a couple of absolute duds, Rodgers has gotten his season pointed in the right direction with back-to-back games against AFC North foes. He threw for 292 yards, 3 TDs, and 1 INT against Cincinnati in Week 3, and he followed that up with 299 yards, 3 TDs, and 2 INTs on Thursday night. It's not always pretty, but the 42-year-old showed he can still recapture the magic now and then with some great throws, including a dart to Darnell Washington for a touchdown. Rodgers has played his way back into the QB2 conversation for fantasy owners.
This article originally appeared on USA TODAY: Throwback performance from Aaron Rodgers
